interviews.name: Dolores Nwachukwu
interviews.fallback: contract-invalid: invalid CITIZEN_INTERVIEW/1 output: answer must be quote|abstain
interviews.raw: {"answer":"I can tell you Grand Lake's clearance rate isn't about response times — those are holding fine. It's about the nature of what's coming in there. A lot of it is property crime, and property crime is hard to clear without witnesses or video. We're stretched thin on staff, so we have to prioritize, and when there's no witness and no lead, there's only so much we can do. It's not that we're not trying — it's that the cases that are hardest to close are the ones piling up there.","fact_ids":["F-f62536f1ade9","F-2b009ac87470"],"basis":"direct-reaction","unverifiedLead":null,"abstain_reason":null}

interviews.raw: {"answer":"Grand Lake leading the city in incidents with a 21% clearance rate — that's the part I can't wave off.
